lede: Mountain Village takes up first reading of an ordinance that would move Housing Authority fees out of municipal code and into an annually updated fee schedule — a structural shift in how affordable housing costs get set that's worth understanding before it advances further. Elsewhere, San Miguel County's Housing Code SSR working group meets Tuesday for its eighth session on stripping Land Use Code barriers to workforce housing, the BOCC has a full plate Wednesday including a view-plain MOU tied to a 1999 settlement, and HARC takes a hard look at a potential demolition and new construction proposal for Rebekah Hall, the very building where they meet.
